# SECTION 1: TOP-LEVEL DISPATCHER
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

tv_check_all_milestones_effect = {
	tv_check_conquest_milestones_effect = yes
	tv_check_prosperity_milestones_effect = yes
	tv_check_trade_milestones_effect = yes
	tv_check_diplomatic_milestones_effect = yes
	tv_check_cultural_milestones_effect = yes
	tv_check_science_milestones_effect = yes
}

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION: CONQUEST SCORE UPDATER
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

tv_update_conquest_score_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = tv_conquest_score value = num_locations }
	set_variable = { name = tv_conquest_subj_temp value = 0 }
	every_subject_or_below = {
		root = {
			change_variable = { name = tv_conquest_subj_temp add = { value = prev.num_locations } }
		}
	}
	change_variable = { name = tv_conquest_subj_temp divide = 2 }
	change_variable = { name = tv_conquest_score add = var:tv_conquest_subj_temp }
}

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION: PROSPERITY SCORE UPDATER
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

tv_update_prosperity_score_effect = {
	# 1. 计数领地
	set_variable = { name = tv_num_locs value = 0 }
	every_owned_location = {
		root = { change_variable = { name = tv_num_locs add = 1 } }
	}
	# 2. 累加总量：total_pop + Σdev + tax_base
	set_variable = { name = tv_raw_score value = total_population }
	set_variable = { name = tv_sum_dev value = 0 }
	every_owned_location = {
		root = { change_variable = { name = tv_sum_dev add = { value = prev.development } } }
	}
	change_variable = { name = tv_raw_score add = var:tv_sum_dev }
	change_variable = { name = tv_raw_score add = country_tax_base }
	# 3. base_score = raw × 100 / (N + 100)  递减规模惩罚
	set_variable = { name = tv_denom value = var:tv_num_locs }
	change_variable = { name = tv_denom add = 100 }
	change_variable = { name = tv_raw_score multiply = 100 }
	change_variable = { name = tv_raw_score divide = var:tv_denom }
	set_variable = { name = tv_prosperity_score value = var:tv_raw_score }
	# 4. 稳定度乘数：× (100 + stability) / 100
	set_variable = { name = tv_stab_factor value = stability }
	change_variable = { name = tv_stab_factor add = 100 }
	change_variable = { name = tv_prosperity_score multiply = var:tv_stab_factor }
	change_variable = { name = tv_prosperity_score divide = 100 }
	# 5. 政体权力乘数（君主=合法性，共和=传统，等）
	if = {
		limit = { government_type = government_type:monarchy }
		set_variable = { name = tv_gov_power value = legitimacy }
		change_variable = { name = tv_prosperity_score multiply = var:tv_gov_power }
		change_variable = { name = tv_prosperity_score divide = 100 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { government_type = government_type:republic }
		set_variable = { name = tv_gov_power value = republican_tradition }
		change_variable = { name = tv_prosperity_score multiply = var:tv_gov_power }
		change_variable = { name = tv_prosperity_score divide = 100 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { government_type = government_type:theocracy }
		set_variable = { name = tv_gov_power value = devotion }
		change_variable = { name = tv_prosperity_score multiply = var:tv_gov_power }
		change_variable = { name = tv_prosperity_score divide = 100 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { government_type = government_type:tribe }
		set_variable = { name = tv_gov_power value = tribal_cohesion }
		change_variable = { name = tv_prosperity_score multiply = var:tv_gov_power }
		change_variable = { name = tv_prosperity_score divide = 100 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { government_type = government_type:steppe_horde }
		set_variable = { name = tv_gov_power value = horde_unity }
		change_variable = { name = tv_prosperity_score multiply = var:tv_gov_power }
		change_variable = { name = tv_prosperity_score divide = 100 }
	}
}

# ── Conquest Victory ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
tv_check_conquest_milestones_effect = {
	tv_update_conquest_score_effect = yes
	# Initialise on first call (guards against missing variable)
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_conquest_milestone } }
		set_variable = { name = tv_conquest_milestone value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_conquest_milestone < 1
			tv_conquest_milestone_1 = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_conquest_milestone value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = tv_conquest.1
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_conquest_milestone < 2
			tv_conquest_milestone_2 = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_conquest_milestone value = 2 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = tv_conquest.2
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_conquest_milestone < 3
			tv_conquest_milestone_3 = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_conquest_milestone value = 3 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = tv_conquest.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_conquest_milestone < 4
			tv_conquest_milestone_4 = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_conquest_milestone value = 4 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = tv_conquest.4
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_conquest_milestone < 5
			tv_conquest_milestone_5 = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_conquest_milestone value = 5 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = tv_conquest.5
	}
}

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 3: PROGRESS PERCENTAGE UPDATER
# Stores tv_*_progress_pct in [0, 100] for each path (used by GUI bars).
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

tv_update_all_progress_pct_effect = {
	# ── Conquest Victory ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	# piecewise: thresholds 150/300/500/1000/2000 → each milestone = +20%
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_conquest_score }
		# Seg 1: 0–150 → 0–20
		set_variable = { name = tv_conquest_progress_pct value = var:tv_conquest_score }
		change_variable = { name = tv_conquest_progress_pct multiply = 20 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_conquest_progress_pct divide = 150 }
		# Seg 2: 150–300 → 20–40
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_conquest_score >= 150 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_conquest_progress_pct value = var:tv_conquest_score }
			change_variable = { name = tv_conquest_progress_pct subtract = 150 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_conquest_progress_pct multiply = 20 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_conquest_progress_pct divide = 150 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_conquest_progress_pct add = 20 }
		}
		# Seg 3: 300–500 → 40–60
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_conquest_score >= 300 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_conquest_progress_pct value = var:tv_conquest_score }
			change_variable = { name = tv_conquest_progress_pct subtract = 300 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_conquest_progress_pct multiply = 20 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_conquest_progress_pct divide = 200 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_conquest_progress_pct add = 40 }
		}
		# Seg 4: 500–1000 → 60–80
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_conquest_score >= 500 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_conquest_progress_pct value = var:tv_conquest_score }
			change_variable = { name = tv_conquest_progress_pct subtract = 500 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_conquest_progress_pct multiply = 20 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_conquest_progress_pct divide = 500 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_conquest_progress_pct add = 60 }
		}
		# Seg 5: 1000–2000 → 80–100
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_conquest_score >= 1000 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_conquest_progress_pct value = var:tv_conquest_score }
			change_variable = { name = tv_conquest_progress_pct subtract = 1000 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_conquest_progress_pct multiply = 20 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_conquest_progress_pct divide = 1000 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_conquest_progress_pct add = 80 }
		}
		if = { limit = { var:tv_conquest_progress_pct > 100 } set_variable = { name = tv_conquest_progress_pct value = 100 } }
	}

	# ── Prosperity Victory ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	# piecewise: thresholds 5000/8000/12000/18000/25000 → each milestone = +20%
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_prosperity_score }
		# Seg 1: 0–5000 → 0–20
		set_variable = { name = tv_prosperity_progress_pct value = var:tv_prosperity_score }
		change_variable = { name = tv_prosperity_progress_pct multiply = 20 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_prosperity_progress_pct divide = 5000 }
		# Seg 2: 5000–8000 → 20–40
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_prosperity_score >= 5000 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_prosperity_progress_pct value = var:tv_prosperity_score }
			change_variable = { name = tv_prosperity_progress_pct subtract = 5000 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_prosperity_progress_pct multiply = 20 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_prosperity_progress_pct divide = 3000 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_prosperity_progress_pct add = 20 }
		}
		# Seg 3: 8000–12000 → 40–60
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_prosperity_score >= 8000 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_prosperity_progress_pct value = var:tv_prosperity_score }
			change_variable = { name = tv_prosperity_progress_pct subtract = 8000 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_prosperity_progress_pct multiply = 20 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_prosperity_progress_pct divide = 4000 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_prosperity_progress_pct add = 40 }
		}
		# Seg 4: 12000–18000 → 60–80
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_prosperity_score >= 12000 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_prosperity_progress_pct value = var:tv_prosperity_score }
			change_variable = { name = tv_prosperity_progress_pct subtract = 12000 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_prosperity_progress_pct multiply = 20 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_prosperity_progress_pct divide = 6000 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_prosperity_progress_pct add = 60 }
		}
		# Seg 5: 18000–25000 → 80–100
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_prosperity_score >= 18000 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_prosperity_progress_pct value = var:tv_prosperity_score }
			change_variable = { name = tv_prosperity_progress_pct subtract = 18000 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_prosperity_progress_pct multiply = 20 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_prosperity_progress_pct divide = 7000 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_prosperity_progress_pct add = 80 }
		}
		if = { limit = { var:tv_prosperity_progress_pct > 100 } set_variable = { name = tv_prosperity_progress_pct value = 100 } }
	}

	# ── Trade Victory ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	# piecewise: thresholds 100/200/400/1000/2000 → each milestone = +20%
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_trade_score }
		# Seg 1: 0–100 → 0–20
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_progress_pct value = var:tv_trade_score }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_progress_pct multiply = 20 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_progress_pct divide = 100 }
		# Seg 2: 100–200 → 20–40
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_score >= 100 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_progress_pct value = var:tv_trade_score }
			change_variable = { name = tv_trade_progress_pct subtract = 100 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_trade_progress_pct multiply = 20 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_trade_progress_pct divide = 100 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_trade_progress_pct add = 20 }
		}
		# Seg 3: 200–400 → 40–60
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_score >= 200 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_progress_pct value = var:tv_trade_score }
			change_variable = { name = tv_trade_progress_pct subtract = 200 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_trade_progress_pct multiply = 20 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_trade_progress_pct divide = 200 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_trade_progress_pct add = 40 }
		}
		# Seg 4: 400–1000 → 60–80
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_score >= 400 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_progress_pct value = var:tv_trade_score }
			change_variable = { name = tv_trade_progress_pct subtract = 400 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_trade_progress_pct multiply = 20 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_trade_progress_pct divide = 600 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_trade_progress_pct add = 60 }
		}
		# Seg 5: 1000–2000 → 80–100
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_score >= 1000 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_progress_pct value = var:tv_trade_score }
			change_variable = { name = tv_trade_progress_pct subtract = 1000 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_trade_progress_pct multiply = 20 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_trade_progress_pct divide = 1000 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_trade_progress_pct add = 80 }
		}
		if = { limit = { var:tv_trade_progress_pct > 100 } set_variable = { name = tv_trade_progress_pct value = 100 } }
	}

	# ── Diplomatic Victory ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	# piecewise: thresholds 50/120/220/380/580 → each milestone = +20%
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_diplomatic_victory_points }
		# Seg 1: 0–50 → 0–20
		set_variable = { name = tv_diplomatic_progress_pct value = var:tv_diplomatic_victory_points }
		change_variable = { name = tv_diplomatic_progress_pct multiply = 20 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_diplomatic_progress_pct divide = 50 }
		# Seg 2: 50–120 → 20–40
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_diplomatic_victory_points >= 50 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_diplomatic_progress_pct value = var:tv_diplomatic_victory_points }
			change_variable = { name = tv_diplomatic_progress_pct subtract = 50 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_diplomatic_progress_pct multiply = 20 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_diplomatic_progress_pct divide = 70 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_diplomatic_progress_pct add = 20 }
		}
		# Seg 3: 120–220 → 40–60
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_diplomatic_victory_points >= 120 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_diplomatic_progress_pct value = var:tv_diplomatic_victory_points }
			change_variable = { name = tv_diplomatic_progress_pct subtract = 120 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_diplomatic_progress_pct multiply = 20 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_diplomatic_progress_pct divide = 100 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_diplomatic_progress_pct add = 40 }
		}
		# Seg 4: 220–380 → 60–80
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_diplomatic_victory_points >= 220 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_diplomatic_progress_pct value = var:tv_diplomatic_victory_points }
			change_variable = { name = tv_diplomatic_progress_pct subtract = 220 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_diplomatic_progress_pct multiply = 20 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_diplomatic_progress_pct divide = 160 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_diplomatic_progress_pct add = 60 }
		}
		# Seg 5: 380–580 → 80–100
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_diplomatic_victory_points >= 380 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_diplomatic_progress_pct value = var:tv_diplomatic_victory_points }
			change_variable = { name = tv_diplomatic_progress_pct subtract = 380 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_diplomatic_progress_pct multiply = 20 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_diplomatic_progress_pct divide = 200 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_diplomatic_progress_pct add = 80 }
		}
		if = { limit = { var:tv_diplomatic_progress_pct > 100 } set_variable = { name = tv_diplomatic_progress_pct value = 100 } }
	}

	# ── Cultural Victory ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	# piecewise: thresholds 50/120/220/380/580 → each milestone = +20%
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_cultural_influence_points }
		# Seg 1: 0–50 → 0–20
		set_variable = { name = tv_cultural_progress_pct value = var:tv_cultural_influence_points }
		change_variable = { name = tv_cultural_progress_pct multiply = 20 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_cultural_progress_pct divide = 50 }
		# Seg 2: 50–120 → 20–40
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_cultural_influence_points >= 50 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_cultural_progress_pct value = var:tv_cultural_influence_points }
			change_variable = { name = tv_cultural_progress_pct subtract = 50 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_cultural_progress_pct multiply = 20 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_cultural_progress_pct divide = 70 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_cultural_progress_pct add = 20 }
		}
		# Seg 3: 120–220 → 40–60
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_cultural_influence_points >= 120 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_cultural_progress_pct value = var:tv_cultural_influence_points }
			change_variable = { name = tv_cultural_progress_pct subtract = 120 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_cultural_progress_pct multiply = 20 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_cultural_progress_pct divide = 100 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_cultural_progress_pct add = 40 }
		}
		# Seg 4: 220–380 → 60–80
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_cultural_influence_points >= 220 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_cultural_progress_pct value = var:tv_cultural_influence_points }
			change_variable = { name = tv_cultural_progress_pct subtract = 220 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_cultural_progress_pct multiply = 20 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_cultural_progress_pct divide = 160 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_cultural_progress_pct add = 60 }
		}
		# Seg 5: 380–580 → 80–100
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_cultural_influence_points >= 380 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_cultural_progress_pct value = var:tv_cultural_influence_points }
			change_variable = { name = tv_cultural_progress_pct subtract = 380 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_cultural_progress_pct multiply = 20 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_cultural_progress_pct divide = 200 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_cultural_progress_pct add = 80 }
		}
		if = { limit = { var:tv_cultural_progress_pct > 100 } set_variable = { name = tv_cultural_progress_pct value = 100 } }
	}

	# ── Scientific Victory ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	# piecewise: thresholds 100/150/200/300/400 → each milestone = +20%
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_science_score }
		# Seg 1: 0–100 → 0–20
		set_variable = { name = tv_science_progress_pct value = var:tv_science_score }
		change_variable = { name = tv_science_progress_pct multiply = 20 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_science_progress_pct divide = 100 }
		# Seg 2: 100–150 → 20–40
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_science_score >= 100 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_science_progress_pct value = var:tv_science_score }
			change_variable = { name = tv_science_progress_pct subtract = 100 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_science_progress_pct multiply = 20 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_science_progress_pct divide = 50 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_science_progress_pct add = 20 }
		}
		# Seg 3: 150–200 → 40–60
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_science_score >= 150 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_science_progress_pct value = var:tv_science_score }
			change_variable = { name = tv_science_progress_pct subtract = 150 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_science_progress_pct multiply = 20 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_science_progress_pct divide = 50 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_science_progress_pct add = 40 }
		}
		# Seg 4: 200–300 → 60–80
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_science_score >= 200 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_science_progress_pct value = var:tv_science_score }
			change_variable = { name = tv_science_progress_pct subtract = 200 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_science_progress_pct multiply = 20 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_science_progress_pct divide = 100 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_science_progress_pct add = 60 }
		}
		# Seg 5: 300–400 → 80–100
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_science_score >= 300 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_science_progress_pct value = var:tv_science_score }
			change_variable = { name = tv_science_progress_pct subtract = 300 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_science_progress_pct multiply = 20 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_science_progress_pct divide = 100 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_science_progress_pct add = 80 }
		}
		if = { limit = { var:tv_science_progress_pct > 100 } set_variable = { name = tv_science_progress_pct value = 100 } }
	}

}

# Called from events tv.<path>.<n> after the milestone is first reached.

tv_grant_conquest_milestone_1 = {
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_conquest_m1_bonus days = -1 }
}

# Diplomatic Victory
tv_grant_diplomatic_milestone_1 = {
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_diplomatic_m1_bonus days = -1 }
	# Create the Diplomatic Alliance international organization
	if = {
	    limit = { NOT = { exists = international_organization:tv_diplomatic_alliance } }
	    create_international_organization = {
	        type = international_organization_type:tv_diplomatic_alliance
	        add_country_to_international_organization = root
	        set_leader_country = root
	    }
	    # Add all existing supporters to the organization
	    every_country = {
	        limit = {
	            has_variable = tv_diplomatic_supporter_of
	            var:tv_diplomatic_supporter_of = root
	        }
	        international_organization:tv_diplomatic_alliance = {
	            add_country_to_international_organization = prev
	        }
	    }
	    # Initialize cohesion and alliance tier on the newly created IO
	    international_organization:tv_diplomatic_alliance = {
	        set_variable = { name = tv_alliance_cohesion value = 0 }
	        set_variable = { name = tv_alliance_tier value = 0 }
	    }
	    # Store alliance tier on the country for trigger access
	    set_variable = { name = tv_alliance_tier value = 0 }
	}
}

tv_grant_diplomatic_milestone_2 = {
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_diplomatic_m2_bonus days = -1 }
}

tv_grant_diplomatic_milestone_3 = {
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_diplomatic_m3_bonus days = -1 }
}

tv_grant_diplomatic_milestone_4 = {
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_diplomatic_m4_bonus days = -1 }
}

tv_grant_diplomatic_milestone_5 = {
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_diplomatic_m5_bonus days = -1 }
}
